title: Mecha Shifty stage
summary: A one-stage April Fools version: Shifty and her Mecha Shiftys against raging Mecha Shiftys.

sections.title: The Invasion of Raging Mecha Shiftys
items:
The invasion of Raging Shiftys has begun.
Set up towers to stop the raging Shiftys.
Everyone already knows this, so I can't be bothered to write the tutorial.

sections.title: Set up towers and defend
items:
Tap the tower slot to select where to place the tower.
Tap the tower button to choose the tower you want to place.
Tap again to confirm.
In short: Just keep tapping, and you'll be all set.

sections.title: About Shifty
items:

SHIfty travels to
France.

sections.title: Small Raging Mecha Shifty Info
items:
A small but precious Mecha Shifty.
Looks extremely angry, but there's nothing it can do.

sections.title: Mega Mecha Shifty Info
items:

Giant mecha girls are always right.

sections.title: Shifty
sections.sub: Shifty will head to the front line. While most of her attacks miss, they will occasionally hit the target and deal fatal damage. Using her Burst Skill will concentrate fire on a chosen spot, although most attacks will still miss.

sections.title: Mecha Shifty
sections.sub: Mecha Shifty has arrived! She attacks multiple enemies simultaneously with a powerful Machine Gun. When her Burst Skill is activated, her giant head will fall, instilling unforgettable terror in her enemies.

sections.title: Mecha Shifty: Burst Skill
sections.note: The Burst Skill levels up with the tower. Power is the game’s damage value (meaning of the scale unclear).
rows:
Robots must not harm humans.
But robots may be harmed.
Drag onto the map; cooldown 40 s

But they can ignore non-human-like humans.

Robots must protect themselves.
They must arm themselves with superior weapons and attributes.
Drag onto the map; cooldown 40 s
Enemies hit: takes 20% more damage for 6 s
Experience the shock and terror, you inferior species.
